HDR is seeking a Senior Hydrogeologist/ Project Manager with at least 10 or more years experience. This individual will support our on-going work load and develop new opportunities in water supply development, water management, and water supply reliability. Ground water hydrology (e.g, hydrogeology) experience in the fields of water supply, aquifer recharge, water rights, and contamination is desired.

The primary duties of this position will be to provide leadership, coordination, technical support and project management for the planning and design of water resources related projects and programs. Type of projects will include: municipal/industrial water supply, water rights, water management plans, mining, flood control, groundwater contamination, stormwater and hydropower. Duties will include client and project management; support of business development activities; and leading projects that that include field work, summarizing background information, analyses, modeling, writing technical reports, and performing various water resources studies.

Skills in ground water modeling, GIS, ground water quality, water rights, well design and construction, and aquifer testing are necessary. Strong computational skills, field experience, and a Master’s Degree preferred. The ideal candidate will have complimentary experience in one or more of the following areas: surface water hydrology/hydraulics, water planning, pumps and distribution system analysis, and water quality. This is a good opportunity for a self-motivated individual to work on a wide range of water resources projects across the Mid-Western and Western U.S.

Business Development

The position may also require client management, coordination with HDR regional and national programs, business development, scoping new work, and preparing proposals. Establish client relations and drive a program of water resources related business in the local/regional market. Familiarity and established relationships with local water resources clients in the state and region is a plus.

Provide high-level technical expertise with regard to hydraulic/hydrologic analysis, modeling and investigation
Specialize in project areas that have greater scope and complexity
Plan and develop projects or design activities that have significant impact on major company programs as needed
Plan, organize and supervise work of medium to large staff of professionals and technicians
Serve as Project Manager on larger projects as needed, though project management is not sole focus of position

Have local market/industry project experience and client connections
10 or more years of experience as a senior hydrogeologist or equivalent position

10 or more years of analysis, modeling and design and management experience
Project management skills a plus

Description

, Weapons Sensors, Advanced Sensors and Protective Technologies Portfolio

Our team solves important problems that make a difference and support our customers in the current and future defense of our nation; primarily in the areas of modeling & simulation (M&S) , sensor integration & characterization, data analysis, algorithm development, and testing for electro-optical infrared (EO/IR) systems

provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here!

Are you ready to make an impact? Share your resume with us today!

Primary Responsibilities.

Work closely with a team of engineers and scientists to develop analysis scripts, data processing pipelines, and data products.
Assist with data collections to include cleaning and validating data collected from multiple sources.
Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and insights that support program objectives.
Develop data visualizations to support analysis products.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and provide input into SW, M&S, and test plan development.
Implement industry standard and custom performance metrics.
Document analysis methodologies, processes, and findings.
Assist with design of experiments (DoE) and conducting parametric trade studies.
Enhance current M&S capabilities to narrow gap between real and synthetic data.
Conduct exploratory data analysis.

Basic Qualifications.

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in data science, mathematics, computer science, or an equivalent engineering or science degree with relevant analysis-related experience plus 4-8 years of experience in a related field or Master’s degree from an accredited university in data science, mathematics, computer science, or an equivalent engineering or science degree, or an equivalent engineering or science degree with relevant software-related experience plus 2-6 years of experience in a related field.
Intermediate ability in Python with familiarity using statistical and data analysis libraries (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, scikit-image, statsmodels, etc.) and data visualization libraries (matplotlib, seaborn, plotly, etc).
Experience analyzing large datasets containing mixed data types.
Proficiency developing data visualization products.
Knowledge of a variety of ML architectures to include classical ML techniques as well as modern deep learning (DL) architectures for supervised and unsupervised learning.
Candidate must be a resident of the North Alabama area or willing to relocate to the Huntsville - North Alabama, AL area.
Active SECRET clearance or above.

Preferred Qualifications.

Experience evaluating or developing computer vision algorithms for object detection, recognition, and tracking.
Experience with evaluating or developing machine learning solutions.
Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques for performing exploratory data analysis, comparing distributions of data, and for performing low dimensional embedding.
Familiarity or interest in EO/IR phenomenology and experience with image processing.
Familiarity with C++ programming.

jobs.description:
Integration meets Innovation
At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.
As a Product Data Analyst  you will play a critical role in Celigo’s success and help execute quantitative research tasks throughout the product development lifecycle to ensure that we’re solving the right problems and providing the right solutions for our target audiences and users. The Product Data Analyst  works strategically, proactively, and collaboratively to inform and influence product roadmaps and business goals.

We are seeking a Product Data Analyst to partner closely with UX Research, Product Management, Design, Content, Engineering, and Customer-facing teams to uncover actionable insights from behavioral and product usage data.
This role sits within the UX Research team in the Product organization and will partner closely with  product managers and designers to uncover actionable insights from behavioral and product usage data.
This is not a reporting-only role. It is a strategic position focused on uncovering, identifying, and transforming complex data into clear recommendations that drive measurable improvements in user experience, adoption, retention, and business impact.
What would you do if hired?
Partner with members of the Design, Content, and Product Management teams to uncover what they need to learn from quantitative data sources (and why) and then identify, pull, and analyze the necessary data to provide them with actionable insights rather than tables of raw data.
Collaborate closely with designers to define, track, and report on metrics that demonstrate the business and user impact of their work as well as craft measurable hypotheses for new and existing features.
Be curious, proactively analyze data, and surface insights that influence product strategy, roadmap decisions, and customer experience improvements.
Help train peers to effectively utilize user research findings and usage metrics to guide and improve design decisions.
Support research operations tasks such as pulling recruitment lists and answering ad-hoc data questions.
Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting frameworks that empower cross-functional teams.
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
Identify leading indicators of engagement, activation, retention, and expansion.
Collaborate with Product Operations, Engineering, and Data teams to ensure clean, reliable event tracking and instrumentation.
Influence stakeholders across functions to gain support for research-based, user-centric solutions.

Who are we looking for?
Skills & Abilities
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills, along with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to multitask and operate as a consultant across multiple product areas.
Ability to analyze and synthesize data, and guide product managers, designers, and engineers on how to act on the findings.
Aptitude for learning complex technological concepts.
Actively seeks and offers candid, constructive feedback with curiosity, humility, and openness.

Education & Experience

4–6+ years of experience in Product Analytics or a similar role supporting B2B SaaS or enterprise software products.
Strong SQL skills and experience querying large datasets from multiple applications in a data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake).
Experience working with product analytics tools (e.g., Pendo, Google Analytics) and BI tools (e.g., Sigma).
Experience in defining and measuring KPIs such as activation, engagement, retention, churn, and feature adoption.
Work samples (case studies, portfolio, website, or similar) demonstrating the depth and breadth of your abilities, and their impact on the business.
Experience working in B2B SaaS, enterprise, or technically complex platforms.
Proven experience working with multi-disciplinary teams (Design, Engineering, Business, R&D, and others) to ideate, iterate, launch, and refine new product designs.
Experience with statistical tools (e.g., R, Python). Experience with methods such as cluster analysis, multivariate regressions, and two-proportion Z-tests is a plus.
Degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field (or equivalent experience).
